name: Elliot
source:
Elliot is the leader of a small town deep in the mountains.

He protects the people there with his life, staying out of any and all conflict that he can say doesn’t concern them.

He is scared of failing his people, like he failed others in the past.

[From the [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/10C18D9dLZ_jKI1p7anhfTTnWz5Nkdzt36bNyxHIqcFQ]casting submission form[/url]]
